data.name: Alpine Rush
data.detailed_description:
Alpine Rush is an open-world survival racing RPG set across the mountain roads and backstreets of late 1990's Japan - where JDM culture is a way of life and every car tells a story of the driver who built it.
Explore a living alpine world by day and night: touge switchbacks, rain-soaked city streets, forestry trails and remote mountain passes. Every drive matters - tires wear and overheat, engines and transmissions take real wear and damage, brakes and oil liquids degrade, and a neglected car simply doesn't drive as good as a healthy one.

Chose your character class. The Race Pilot lives for the tarmac - Time Attacks, Rival Duels flagged down straight out of passing traffic, and high-stakes night races. The Offroader goes where the tarmac ends - Rescue Runs, Cargo Hauls and deliveries through terrain that punishes bad planning, with no gas station for miles. Both classes grow through their own Skill Trees, with active and passive skills that change how the car and the driver perform.

Build the car that build your reputation: suspension geometry, gearing, forced induction and a full aftermarket parts catalog, alongside body work, foil wrapping and full repaints. Customize your garage - lifts, functional tools, crafting benches built from scrap salvaged from wrecked rivals.

Every item you carry has real weight and purpose. Overload your car and feel it in the handling. Manage you stash and decide what is a must to carry and what to leave behind.

FEATURES

  • Realistic driving physics across road, off-road, and extreme terrain

  • Vast open world with Japanese alpine roads, forests, rivers, and mountain passes

  • Dynamic quests & rival races with evolving AI and high-stakes challenges

  • Full vehicle tuning & customization — engines, suspension, tires, setup, visuals

  • Deep progression system with driver stats, skills, perks, and XP

  • Survival-driven Inventory System with tools, repairs, fuel management, and resource handling

  • Realistic car damage & wear affecting performance and handling

  • Studio-quality sound design powered by Wwise

  • Day/night cycle & weather changing how every drive feels

  • Purpose-built vehicles for racing, off-roading, heavy hauling or rescue missions

Enjoy what you see? Wishlist Alpine Rush to support development and get notified as new content, updates, and releases roll out. Your Wishlist helps the game grow!

data.short_description: Alpine Rush is an open-world survival racing game set in late 1990's Japan - where JDM culture is a way of life. You explore, race, complete quests, and build your driver through stats and skills. Tune vehicles, master tough terrain, and compete in dynamic challenges across a living alpine world.
